sources.note: Classification Kru > Eastern > Bakwe; alternate names Hwane, Ngwané; 2,100 speakers (1993 SIL). No typology or bibliography visible (paywalled).

sources.citation: Delafosse, Maurice. 1904. Vocabulaires comparatifs de plus de 60 langues ou dialectes parlés à la Côte d'Ivoire et dans les régions limitrophes. Paris: Ernest Leroux. [Glottolog Glottolog's most extensive description for wane1242, 'a wordlist or less']
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Wané ('Hwine ou Hwané (Houané), appelés aussi Bodo', p. 70) is represented only by a 1-10 numeral column in the 'Groupe bakoué' table (p. 74), collected by G. Thomann. The general introduction (p. 3) says only that 'l'accent tonique ou plutôt l'intonation' cannot be marked alphabetically; no Wané-specific accent note.

sources.citation: Vogler, Pierre. 2017. Contribution à la classification des langues kru (Niger-Congo). Ms., 74 pp. (v2), HAL hal-01574391 [= Glottolog ref 589953, cited for wane1242 'pp. 38-60'].
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Comparative lexicon and subclassification of Kru; Wané occurs only twice (PDF p. 43, sec. 3.81 and ex. 286a: numerals '1' wané lo, '4'), data from Delafosse 1904: 74. No phonological description of Wané; nothing on stress or accent.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid pages wane1242, bakw1242 (Bakwe-Wane), bakw1243 (Bakwé), east2415, and reference records 589953 / 60421 / 308018; Glottolog langdoc search for 'wané', 'bakwé', 'hwane'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Wané, Bakwé and the Bakwe-Wane group all carry the same three comparative references (Vogler 2017, Marchese 1989, Zogbo 2012) plus Ethnologue; Glottolog's most extensive description for Wané is Delafosse 1904 (a wordlist or less). No descriptive reference exists; langdoc searches return nothing.

Certains d'entre eux prétendent comprendre le bakwé. Malheureusement, nous n'avons pas d'autres renseignements sur ce groupe.
